new_findings.title: Reject method descriptors before named-selector resolution
new_findings.cause: loadTestsFromName calls getattr(TestCaseClass,part) before ordinary_test_class is checked by frozen_cases. An unsupported descriptor can alias itself to another body before that guard sees the class.
new_findings.observed: Both exact proposed runners return SURVIVED/exit0 with selected C.test_second, invalid_population=[], trace descriptor,first. The retained original second body is absent.
new_findings.fix: Validate an ordinary TestCase class before accessing a method selector and avoid invoking custom descriptors. Refuse non-module/non-TestCase object traversal rather than allowing selector factory side effects.
